#!name=山姆会员商店
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = api-sams.walmartmobile.cn

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-sams\.walmartmobile\.cn\/api\/v\d\/sams\/sams-user\/(window\/getGoUpPlus|screen_promotion\/get)/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-sams\.walmartmobile\.cn\/api\/v\d\/sams\/channel\/portal\/AdgroupData/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-sams\.walmartmobile\.cn\/api\/v\d\/sams\/configuration\/personCenterEntrance\/query/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-sams\.walmartmobile\.cn\/api\/v\d\/sams\/trade\/order\/getOftenBuyGoods/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-sams\.walmartmobile\.cn\/api\/v\d\/sams\/goods-portal\/spu\/searchRecommendPool/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-sams\.walmartmobile\.cn\/api\/v\d\/sams\/configuration\/appVersionUpdate\/getAppVersionUpdateInfo/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-sams\.walmartmobile\.cn\/api\/v1\/sams\/configuration\/portal\/beUpdate/i then reject_dict(200)
